drg.description: Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 63-year-old female admitted for urinary tract infection. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.41, creatinine 2.02-2.04, hemoglobin 12.8-12.9, platelets 263-267, sodium 141, wbc 8.7; vitals dbp 69-72, heart_rate 84-86, map 90-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 131-139, spo2 97-98, temp 37-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Urinalysis: positive nitrites, >50 WBC/hpf; Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2, hemoglobin 12.8-13, platelets 264-267, sodium 140-141, wbc 8.4-8.5; vitals dbp 69-74, heart_rate 85-88, map 90-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 131-138, spo2 97-98, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 63-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Urinary tract infection. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
